title: Use wildcard or regex in cookie name in Cookie Authentication

raw.title: Use wildcard or regex in cookie name in Cookie Authentication
raw.body:
Hi,
I need to use Cookie Authentication for my APIs, but the authentication cookie name's in my app changes every time you log in (only the cookie name prefix is known: _shibsession_).

I was looking for a way to specify cookies name pattern instead of the exact name. Is there such a feature?
